1.name: Tongue River Valley Ranch
1.conservation_easement_notes: No mention of easement found; status unconfirmed
1.notes: 23,237± total acres (13,757± deeded + BLM/State/private leases). Native grass, regenerative grazing, diverse wildlife. One of the largest contiguous ranches on the MT market.

2.name: Hoback River Homestead
2.water_features: 2+ miles both sides of Hoback River, native cutthroat fishery
2.mineral_rights: Owned mineral rights transfer to purchaser
2.conservation_easement_notes: Listing explicitly states NOT encumbered by any conservation easement
2.notes: Family-owned since 1888, first sale in ~140 years. Borders Bridger-Teton Nat'l Forest ~6 miles. ~700 irrigated acres, 30-40 min from Jackson Hole.

3.name: Buck Gulch Ranch
3.notes: 120+ year family livestock operation, Little Snake River Valley on WY/CO border, ~1.5 hrs from Steamboat Springs. Gentle terrain, good grazing/wildlife.

4.name: RC Ranch
4.notes: 22,657± total acres (17,223± deeded + BLM/State lease), 44 mi NW of Laramie. Rated for 850+ cow-calf pairs.

5.name: Harless Ranch
5.notes: ~11,630 total acres (4,374± deeded + BLM/State lease) in south-central NM. Year-round cattle allotment and wildlife habitat.

6.name: Double V Ranch
6.water_features: 25+ miles of creeks, ~1 mile Pecos River frontage
6.conservation_easement_notes: Marketed explicitly as 'unrestricted' — buyers can build/farm/camp freely
6.notes: Largest ranch currently for sale in New Mexico (73,600 acres). 4BR/4BA residence, guest cottages, historic saloon. Up to ~1,200 cow-calf pairs; pronghorn/mule deer/waterfowl hunting.

7.name: Rudio Mountain Ranch
7.water_features: Between North Fork John Day and John Day River drainages
7.notes: 18,643± deeded-acre secured timber/hunting ranch, dense timber stands, no-trespassing private block near Dayville/Kimberly, OR.

8.name: Horseshoe Lake River Ranch
8.water_features: 5 named lakes + ~2 miles Okanogan River frontage; salmon/trout fishery
8.notes: 3,252 acres pairing irrigated river/lake meadows (~175 ac, 60 hay) with timbered rangeland leased for up to 700 head seasonally. Notable Sockeye/Chinook salmon fishing.

9.name: Pioneer Ranch
9.water_features: ~1 mi East Canyon Creek frontage, 35 acre-ft water rights
9.conservation_easement_notes: Upper portion is PERMANENTLY under conservation easement; lower portion remains unencumbered/developable
9.notes: 1,073 acres 25 min from Park City, 9,500 sqft off-grid home, bordered by East Canyon State Park. Elk/moose/mule deer landowner tags, trout fishing.

10.name: Henry's Fork Snake River Ranch
10.water_features: Henry's Fork of the Snake River — world-renowned fly-fishing corridor
10.notes: 1,048-acre legacy ranch near Rexburg combining world-class trout fishing, premier upland/waterfowl hunting, productive irrigated farmland.

11.name: BW Ranch
11.conservation_easement_notes: No easement mentioned; marketed as standard recreational/legacy ranch sale
11.notes: Hill Country box-canyon ranch on headwaters of Myrtle Creek, 12 mi from Bandera, 42 from San Antonio. Live water, panoramic views.

12.name: Elm Creek Ranch
12.water_features: 2 creeks (Big Elm, Little Elm) + 20 stock ponds (one ~5 acres)
12.conservation_easement_notes: No easement mentioned; emphasized as unrestricted ranching/ag use
12.notes: Central Texas ranch with strong surface water, ranch houses, barns, working pens. Suited for ranching, hunting, or investment.

13.name: Twin Creeks Farm
13.conservation_easement_notes: Full page unreachable to verify; unconfirmed
13.notes: Productive timberland, year-round creek frontage, strong wildlife habitat near Ideal, GA.

14.name: Lundy Creek Tract
14.water_features: ~1 mi Lundy Creek frontage + additional creeks, potential pond sites
14.conservation_easement_notes: No easement mentioned; described as unrestricted for timber harvest/development
14.notes: 887± ac planted pine + 350± ac hardwoods near Lake Oconee, 20 min from I-20. Legacy/timber-income tract, no residence.

15.name: Hightower Buck and Timber
15.conservation_easement_notes: No easement mentioned; emphasizes current/future timber harvest value
15.notes: 1,870± acres mixed pine/hardwoods near Franklin, GA, established food plots, strong wildlife habitat.

16.name: Yock River Farms (1,526-acre tract)
16.water_features: ~2.5 mi Yockanookany River frontage, cypress sloughs
16.conservation_easement_notes: ~80 acres of young hardwood ALREADY enrolled in a conservation easement; remainder is unrestricted
16.notes: Bottomland hardwood hunting/timber tract outside Thomastown, 840+ ac mature hardwood, 8+ mi interior roads, adjacent to Natchez Trace.

17.name: 500 Acres in Holmes County
17.conservation_easement_notes: No easement mentioned; markets active game management/development with no stated restrictions
17.notes: Turnkey 500± ac recreational retreat near Lexington, MS. 2,100 sqft lodge, caretaker home, 10 food plots, site of MS state-record buck.

18.name: Moonshine Meadow
18.conservation_easement_notes: No easement referenced; positioned as private legacy estate without noted restrictions
18.notes: 641± ac legacy property, pristine hardwoods, miles of creek frontage, turnkey cabins near Thomaston, easy reach of Atlanta.

19.name: M Bar Tract
19.conservation_easement_notes: Only search-result summary available; no easement language seen but unconfirmed
19.notes: 1,675-acre highly managed timber and pasture property combining pine timber production with pastureland.

20.name: White River Ranch
20.water_features: White River sub-irrigated meadows, Gorr Reservoir, holding ponds, 53.9 ac surface water rights
20.conservation_easement_notes: No easement mentioned across multiple listing sources; marketed purely as grazing/livestock operation
20.notes: 5,888.56-acre contiguous grazing operation near Chadron, supports 800-1,000 head yearlings seasonally. 4BR/2BA residence, new fencing. Seller intends 1031 exchange.

21.name: Paramount Valley Ranch
21.water_features: 42-acre spring-fed lake, Calamus River nearby, 1,140 ac sub-irrigated meadows, Ogallala Aquifer
21.conservation_easement_notes: Only a state school-land lease is referenced as encumbrance, no conservation easement anywhere in materials
21.notes: Self-sustaining Sandhills cattle operation (12,979 deeded/13,617 total ac), rated 885 cow-calf pairs. 6,800-ft runway nearby. Turnkey generational ranch.

22.name: Niobrara River Bugles and Bucks
22.water_features: Bordered by Niobrara River, Jewett & Bear Creeks, 88 ac surface water rights
22.mineral_rights: Owned mineral rights transfer with sale
22.conservation_easement_notes: No easement mentioned; only a state school-land lease (not conservation) noted
22.notes: 1,868.69-acre ranch in NE's Unit 7 Elk Unit, trophy elk/deer hunting. Home, cattle facilities, corrals. Seller open to land contract.

23.name: Oak Canyon Ranch
23.water_features: Coon Creek, numerous dams/ponds, ~5 mi from Missouri River
23.conservation_easement_notes: No easement mentioned across syndications; working cattle/horse operation with full ag/hunting rights
23.notes: Nationally recognized QDMA-managed trophy-whitetail ranch in Missouri River breaks. ~563 ac farmland, ~1,246 ac native pasture, two residences, barns, corrals.

24.name: 609 Acres, Wayne/Union Co.
24.conservation_easement_notes: No easement mentioned; described only as productive tillable farmland, no development/subdivision restriction
24.notes: 609± ac southern Iowa farmland near Corydon — rare large cohesive tillable acreage block.

25.name: 369± Acres on Eau Claire River
25.water_features: ~2,800 ft Eau Claire River frontage on two sides
25.conservation_easement_notes: No easement referenced in any syndicated listing; marketed as unrestricted recreational/timber land
25.notes: Heavily timbered tract, extensive trail network, deer/bear/turkey/grouse, ATV access adjacent to Eisberner Memorial Forest canoe launch.

26.name: Robbins Family Forest
26.water_features: ~2 mi waterfront along Ledge Pond and Kingdom Bog
26.conservation_easement_notes: Currently NOT under easement — listing flags a FUTURE possible 'conservation easement strategy' for a buyer, but confirms no existing restriction today
26.notes: First sale in 30 years. Well-stocked working forest (~$1.2M standing timber), active gravel pit, recreational cabin, operational sugarhouse near Belfast, ME.
